cohort.note: Fixed film teams; not the independently generated league cohort used by calibrate.ts. Explosive pass-play denominator includes sacks and scrambles; explosive completion denominator is throws.

definitions.success: At least 40% of yards to go on first down, 60% on second, 100% on third/fourth; nullified plays and kneels excluded.
definitions.pressure: Recorded defender within 2 yards before throw; association only.
definitions.breakdowns: Actual checked coverage and original called coverage retained separately. Same teams/six games, small unmatched cells with adaptive play selection; descriptive, not causal or NFL concept validation. Missing labels are unknown. Pass-play rates include sacks/scrambles; throw rates use throw events.

passingOutcomes.unclassifiedCauseNote: Other incompletions cannot be separated into accuracy, pressure, mechanics or decision errors from these events. Pressure overlaps outcomes and does not establish causation.
